arabic text: ASEER HOKE CHALI HU SALAM AY BABA\nYAHA SE JAATI HU ZINDAAN-E-SHAAM AY BABA
english translation text: I leave as a captive—my salutations, O Father.\nFrom here I go to the prison of Shaam, O Father.

arabic text:
SUNO SAKINA SE GHAM KA PAYAAM AY BABA,
HAMARE JAL GAYE SARE KHAYAM AYE BABA, KAHAN
KAHAN HO NA JANE QAYAM AY BABA, HAI WAJ HAI
ZEESTH TUMHARA HI NAAM AY BABA
english translation text:
Listen to Sakina’s message of grief, O Father.
All our tents have been burned, O Father.
I do not know where you now rest, O Father;
only your name gives me the strength to live, O Father.

arabic text:
SUNA HAI SHAAM KA DARBAAR JAB BHARA HOGA,
YAZEED KA SAR-E-DARBAAR SAAMNA HOGA, MERA TO
BHAI BHI ZANJEER SE BHANDA HOGA, PHOOPI JO
AYENGI DARBAAR ME TO KYA HOGA
english translation text:
I have heard that when the court of Shaam is assembled,
we will face Yazid before his throne.
My brother too will be bound in chains;
what will happen when my aunt enters that court?

arabic text:
ABHI SE SHAAM KO JAANE KI IBTEDAA DEKHO,
RASAN SE GUT TA HAI BABA, MERA GALA DEKHO,
PHUPHI KE SAR SE BHI TO CHHIN LI RIDAA DEKHO, YE
IBTEDAH HAI TO KYA HON-GI INTEHAA DEKHO
english translation text:
See, even before the journey to Shaam has begun,
the rope is choking my throat, O Father.
See how the veil has been snatched from my aunt’s head.
If this is only the beginning, imagine how it will end.

arabic text:
JO PUCHO SABR TO MEI FATEMA KI POTI HU, MEI
APNE KUNBE KI MAZLOOMIYAT KO ROTI HU, TUMHE NA
PAA KE BOHOT DIL FIGHAAR HOTI HU, CHACHA KE
SAARE BURIDAA PE JAAN KHOTI HU
english translation text:
Ask of my patience: I am Fatima’s granddaughter.
I weep over the oppression suffered by my family.
Without you, my heart is deeply wounded;
I grieve at the sight of my uncle’s severed head.

arabic text:
NA PUCHO HALAT-E-BIMAAR KARBALA BABA, HAMARE
HAI YE BHI SALAAR-E-KAFELA BABA, KUSHI SE SEHGAYE
HAR ZULM HAR JAFAA BABA, HAI AAJ SHAAM KI MANZIL
KA MARHALA BABA
english translation text:
Do not ask about the condition of Karbala’s ailing survivor, O Father.
He is now the leader of our caravan, O Father.
He endured every cruelty and injustice with submission;
today he must face the stage of the journey to Shaam, O Father.
